title: Acme Robotics Deal Review
subtitle: Acme Robotics — Streaming TV Performance Plan, $120K · AE: Jordan Rivera · SDR: Sam Patel · Mgr: Dana Chen
footer_left: Sample — fictional data · Deal Review Generator
summary: Acme Robotics came in warm from a Q1 CTV webinar with a clear mandate to add a measurable, top-of-funnel channel ahead of a spring product launch. SDR Sam Patel booked the discovery call; AE Jordan Rivera ran a tight three-call cycle that aligned on a 4–6× ROAS target and an April go-live. Executive sponsorship from the VP of Marketing and a concrete launch deadline turned an initial $90K scope into a $120K commitment.
context: Enterprise / Direct, new business. Product: Streaming TV Performance Plan. A multi-threaded deal — SDR-sourced, AE-led, with the VP of Marketing (Casey Nguyen) as economic buyer and a marketing analyst validating measurement. The scope grew during proposal after a full-funnel plan (prospecting + retargeting) replaced the initial prospecting-only quote.

timeline.title: Webinar follow-up — SDR outreach
timeline.body: Sam Patel (SDR) follows up on Acme's Q1 CTV webinar registration with a tailored sequence.

timeline.title: Discovery booked
timeline.body: Casey Nguyen (VP Marketing) accepts a discovery call. Demo Booked By: Sam Patel (SDR).

timeline.title: Discovery call — goals & measurement
timeline.body: Aligned on a spring product launch, need for incremental reach, and a 4–6× ROAS goal.

timeline.title: SF: Opportunity created — $90K
timeline.body: Stage set to Discovery; prospecting-only initial scope.

timeline.title: Solution & measurement review
timeline.body: Walked the analyst through attribution and an incrementality study; addressed a creative-specs question.

timeline.title: SF: Amount raised $90K → $120K
timeline.body: Full-funnel plan (prospecting + retargeting) replaces prospecting-only quote.

timeline.title: Proposal review with VP
timeline.body: Casey Nguyen confirms budget and the April launch; verbal commit.

timeline.title: SF: Closed Won — $120K
timeline.body: Signed; kickoff scheduled for the following week.

calls.title: Call 1: Discovery
calls.meta: Feb 19, 2026 · 32 min · Jordan Rivera (AE), Sam Patel (SDR), Casey Nguyen (VP Marketing)
calls.brief: Acme is launching a new product line in spring and wants a measurable top-of-funnel channel beyond search and social. Discussed a 4–6× ROAS goal, an April go-live, and creative readiness.

items.text: Spring product launch — needs incremental reach fast
Search & social are saturating; wants a new channel
Committed to an April go-live date
Creative specs / asset readiness to confirm

calls.title: Call 2: Proposal Review
calls.meta: Mar 12, 2026 · 28 min · Jordan Rivera (AE), Casey Nguyen (VP Marketing), Priya Shah (Analyst)
calls.brief: Reviewed the full-funnel plan and measurement approach. VP confirmed the $120K budget and April launch; analyst satisfied with the incrementality study design.

items.text: Incrementality study answered the analyst's rigor bar

wins.label: Warm, Targeted Origin
wins.text: A relevant webinar gave the SDR a high-intent VP contact — not a cold start.

wins.label: Speed to Value
wins.text: Discovery-to-close in ~3 weeks, tied to a concrete launch date.

wins.label: Outcome Selling
wins.text: Framed on ROAS and seasonality, not features — matched the buyer's mindset.

wins.label: Multi-Threading
wins.text: VP economic buyer plus an analyst de-risked the measurement objection.

wins.label: Scope Expansion
wins.text: A full-funnel plan lifted the deal 33% over the initial quote.

wins.label: Clean Handoff
wins.text: Kickoff scheduled at signature keeps launch momentum.

gaps.label: Gap 1: Creative Readiness
gaps.body: Creative specs were an open item on the discovery call with no linked task tracking asset readiness before launch.
gaps.rec: Auto-create a creative-assets task at Closed Won with an owner and a due date tied to the go-live.

gaps.label: Gap 2: Lead-Source Granularity
gaps.body: Lead Source is 'Webinar' but doesn't capture which webinar or campaign — attribution for event-sourced pipeline is coarse.
gaps.rec: Add a campaign/source detail field so specific events are measurable.

gaps.label: Gap 3: Amount-Change Note
gaps.body: The amount rose $90K → $120K with no reason logged; the scope change lives only in the rep's memory.
gaps.rec: Require a short reason on material amount changes for clean win analysis.

gaps.label: Gap 4: Next-Step Hygiene
gaps.body: Next Step was not consistently updated between the proposal and close stages.
gaps.rec: Flag active opps whose Next Step is unchanged for 7+ days.

gaps.label: Gap 5: Stakeholder Mapping
gaps.body: The analyst (Priya Shah) appeared only at proposal; no contact role was recorded for her earlier.
gaps.rec: Capture contact roles at discovery so the buying group is visible sooner.

gaps.label: Gap 6: Measurement Follow-Through
gaps.body: The incrementality study was scoped but has no owner/date for the post-launch read-out.
gaps.rec: Book the study read-out at close to institutionalize the land → prove → expand loop.
